mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (recipient_id, actor_id, work_id, comment_id, comment_content, type, created_at) VALUES (#{recipientId}, #{actorId}, #{workId}, #{commentId}, #{commentContent}, #{type}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.recipient_id, n.actor_id, n.work_id, n.comment_id, n.comment_content AS content, n.type, n.is_read, n.created_at, u.nickname AS actor_nickname, u.avatar_url AS actor_avatar_url, CASE WHEN n.work_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(w.title, '作品已删除') END AS work_title, w.cover_url AS work_cover_url FROM notifications n LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = n.actor_id LEFT JOIN works w ON w.id = n.work_id WHERE n.recipient_id = #{recipientId} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE recipient_id = #{recipientId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = 1 WHERE recipient_id = #{recipientId} AND is_read = 0
